dump_rail.architecture: BUS-fed independent DUMP_5V from U6 TPS7A4001DGNR; powers U3 TLV1704, U4 UCC27511A and U7 TLV6700; independent of SAFE_5V, MCU, BMS permission and return TTL, but shares BUS/GND_SYS.
dump_rail.effective_capacitance_requirements: U6_CIN >=1uF at maximum BUS bias; U6_COUT >=4.7uF at 5V bias; exact effective values not verified.
dump_rail.output_volts_screen_basis: Assumption-only extrapolated screen: TI TPS7A4001 Rev.B Table 6.5 line-regulation unit is %VOUT; over VIN=7–100 V its typical value is 0.03% VOUT with MIN/MAX blank, not 0.03%/V. Overall accuracy ±2.5% is specified only for VIN <= 24 V. The 4.7771–5.1983 V range at high BUS is not guaranteed; any per-volt multiplication of 0.03% is a user-defined assumption, not a datasheet limit.

precision_reference_alternative.source: Current saved native source and raw official ENET show U7 TLV6700DDCR plus internal 400mV reference and current 1M/10k BUS divider; geometry confirms 169/506/102. New-session reopen not verified after timeouts.

retain_refs: U3 TLV1704A for three phase-negative channels

precision_reference_alternative.threshold_basis: TLV6700 full-temperature VIT+=396–404mV, VIT−=387–400mV; full tolerance/TCR corners of 1.00MΩ ±1% ±100ppm/°C top and 10.0kΩ ±0.1% ±25ppm/°C bottom. Independent envelopes; not paired values, and excludes INB− current at 0.4V because TI does not specify it at that condition.
precision_reference_alternative.deadband: Built-in hysteresis 5.5mV typ/12mV max with no minimum; approximately 0.56V typical and up to 1.24V at BUS. Keep 1nF C0G filter (τ≈9.90µs); this is not a guaranteed minimum deadband.
precision_reference_alternative.logic: U7 pin4=VBUS_OV_SENSE, pin6=BUSOV_N; U4 IN−=BUSOV_N and IN+=DUMP_THERM_OK, so active-low BOV asserts UCC output high only when thermal contact is closed. Candidate U3 unused channel pins10=GND_SYS, 11=DUMP_5V, 13=NC.
precision_reference_alternative.failure_boundary: U7 unpowered with DUMP_5V still alive leaves OUTB high impedance and BUSOV_N pulled high; loss of DUMP_5V leaves UCC below UVLO and Q7 off. Startup may take up to 450µs after U7 VDD exceeds 1.8V. Still a single-point local energy path.
precision_reference_alternative.cost_boundary: No new unique project MPN; no price/MOQ/assembly quote, so no total-cost reduction claim.
precision_reference_alternative.qualification: Implemented topology; these are independent reference/resistor screens, not guarantees or paired threshold values. Native save true; post-save reopen NOT_VERIFIED. No physical/thermal qualification.

bov_threshold_screen.basis: TLV6700 full-temperature internal threshold limits and 1MΩ/10kΩ divider tolerance/TCR corners; excludes unspecified INB− input current at 0.4V, dynamic parasitics and physical measurements.
bov_threshold_screen.note: U7 internal reference no longer depends on TPS7A4001 output accuracy. DUMP_5V must still keep U7 within operating range and UCC27511A above its maximum 4.65V rising UVLO. RSO_W ENET property text defect is separate from pin connectivity.

dump_energy_screen.target_status: The user confirmed N5065 selection at 1.8 kW motor-side bus input; the seller rating conditions are unspecified. No evidence makes local dump absorption of 1.8 kW for 1 s a hard user requirement. One second is a project single-pulse screening assumption; 3.6 kW is only the arithmetic two-board simultaneous extrapolation. The current resistor bank screens 1.522–1.758 kW/board statically; pulse, thermal and system regeneration capability remain unqualified and HOLD.
dump_energy_screen.q7_screen: At upper 41.724V screen and 0.99Ω bank, about42.145A; using 4.5mΩ max RDS at 4.5V x 2.5 hot factor gives about20.0W on-state; 60°C case plus 0.4°C/W yields about68.0°C steady estimate, not 1s transient qualification.
dump_energy_screen.status: paper screening only; external pulse rating, heatsink, case temperature, repeated duty, harness/connector/fuse and actual regen envelope remain unqualified.

buck_valid_interface.parts: BC847C reused for Q_BUCK_CLAMP/Q_BUCK_RELEASE; 1kΩ bias installed on FOC-A only; 4.7kΩ base resistor and 100kΩ base pulldown per board.

qualificationLimits: Official DRC has 6 warnings with no detail; static pin-contract pass is not an electrical qualification.
TPS7A4001 line regulation and output at actual high BUS/load, 127mV UCC UVLO margin, and effective CIN/COUT capacitances need measurement.

TLV6700 BOV resistor/reference screen is 39.209–41.724V ON and 38.318–41.311V release; independent corners, not full guarantees or paired values. Rdump bank is only 1.522–1.758kW/board over the ON screen, below the 1.8kW/1s paper target; actual regen envelope must define the requirement.
VO617A CTR/VCEsat and BC847C saturation are not guaranteed over this exact low-current operating point and full temperature; Buck RT/SD below 0.4V requires bench verification.
Chopper frequency and 1s thermal model are not established; resistor pulse energy, case/heatsink, repeated duty, Q7 thermal behavior, fuse, harness and connector remain open.
Thermal contact open disables dump; Q7 short, U6/U3/U4 failure or absent BUS still needs external source isolation and residual-energy handling.
Motor back-EMF, regen power/time, battery/BMS sink acceptance, inter-board sharing, speed/insulation and thermal limits require system/mechanical inputs and physical tests.
Firmware Break configuration, full PWM/gate behavior, PCB placement/routing and real hardware acceptance remain open.
Root created a new 2026-10-21 BOV-before snapshot ZIP; the previous missing historical archive and its old restore mapping remain unrecovered.
SMCJ40A min breakdown is 44.4V vs 41.724V maximum static BOV screen (2.676V gap); dynamic waveform, source accuracy and TVS pulse energy still require qualification.
KOA 0.5 mOhm shunts are rated 5 W / 100 A. At 100 A continuous each reaches rated power; higher phase-current duty requires a lower limit or thermal redesign.
Hard BOV still has single points: BUS absent, U6/U3/U4/Q7 failed, or thermal contact/wiring open prevents dump; Q7 short cannot be interrupted by its gate.
Full schematic coverage and source/export/hash binding are in 检查/原理图电气复核结论.md; current new-session reopen status is NOT_VERIFIED.
